question: India’s first underwater museum and artificial coral reef will be developed around INS ___________ in Maharashtra.
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Guldar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India’s First Underwater Museum and Artificial Coral Reef to Be Developed Around INS Guldar in Maharashtra.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**India’s first underwater museum** and **artificial coral reef** will be created around **INS Guldar**.

 
 
• 
 
Location: **Nivati Rocks**, **Vengurla**, **Sindhudurg district**, **Maharashtra**.

 
 
• 
 
The warship **INS Guldar** was **decommissioned in January 2024**.

 
 
• 
 
The **Union Tourism Ministry** has approved **₹46.91 crore** for the project.

 
 
• 
 
Aim: Promote **marine conservation**, **scuba diving tourism**, and **submarine tours** in future.

 
 
• 
 
The **ship weighs 1,120 tons** and is now handed over to **Maharashtra Tourism Development Corporation**.
